lcc_original: 永恆主上帝說：『那人獨居不好；我要爲他造個幫助者做他的配偶。』
notes: 耶和華 (YHWH, H03068) → 永恆主: LCC's distinctive rendering of the Tetragrammaton; SN attaches to 永恆主 as a unit
神 (H0430, Elohim) → 上帝: LCC's standard rendering of Elohim
{<WH01961>}{<WTH8800>} kept implicit: LCC also omits the copula between 那人 and 獨居, so no explicit word to attach to

LCC inverts the Hebrew word order of עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ: UNV renders it as 配偶幫助他 (helper-mate first), LCC as 幫助者做他的配偶 (helper first, then counterpart phrase); split accordingly — WH05828 (עֵזֶר) to 幫助者, WAH09003+WAH05048 (כְּנֶגְדּוֹ) to 配偶
UNV's 一個 and LCC's 個 are both bare Chinese measure words with no Hebrew equivalent; neither takes an SN tag
